name: cortico-world-self-checkup

zh.description: 她最近是跑得慢了，还是心思变了？先别急着重装，做一次体检。硬件健康看六项：稳定性、响应速度、缓存与成本、上下文配置、交接健康、记忆健康，每项都有分数、趋势和判断依据——是哪次交接拖慢的、哪段记忆在漏，都指给你看。另一份是性格侧写：28 道情境题她自己答，再拿真实行为痕迹反查，开口习惯、记忆线索、情绪起伏、日常节奏，最后给一张名片，带称号、四个短标签和一段近期观察。两份报告分开算、不合并总分，全程只读不改配置。

en.description: Is she slowing down, or has something about her changed? Run a checkup before you reinstall. The hardware half scores six dimensions — stability, latency, cache and cost, context config, handoff health, memory health — each with a trend and the evidence behind it, so you can see which handoff dragged or where memory is leaking. The other half is playful: 28 situational questions she answers herself, cross-checked against real behavioural traces (opening habits, memory cues, mood swings, daily rhythm) and turned into a card with a title, four labels and a recent observation. Two separate reports, never merged into one score, read-only throughout.
